title: Review of c53's fed vortices on fresh seeds 11 and 12 and a fuel fork: same-sign vortex fission to generation 9 and 7 replicates, all vortices go out within ~55 t of the fork; E is by construction
summary: Labkit runs of the claim's world.py, defaults, 128^2, T=3000 (--frames 1000 --spf 150): seed 11 117 splits, 44 persistent, generation 9, merge/split 0.87; seed 12 61 splits, 32 persistent, generation 7, merge/split 0.84. The claim's splits.py: daughters keep the parent's sign at 42/42 and 32/32 splits with known sign; merges are same-sign at 92/93 and 47/47. sheet (seed 12): band-passed random vorticity at t=0 becomes ~30 discrete vortices of both signs by t=126; rods pinching into two same-sign vortices are visible through t=3000. Fuel fork at t=2000 on seed 11 (fork_t 2000): labkit components 32 (t=2025) -> 21 (2040) -> 1 (2055) -> 0 (2070), against 29-31 in the fed run of the same seed.

observations.S: pack_s12/sheet.png t=0: band-passed random vorticity over the whole box, uniform fuel
observations.I: pack_s12/sheet.png t=126-3000: ~30 separate compact vortices of both signs, each with its own eating halo
observations.D: pack_s11/FACTS.md and pack_s12/FACTS.md: 44 and 32 persistent splits, generation 9 and 7, splits continuing to the end (pack_s11/timeseries.png); splits.py: daughters same sign 42/42 and 32/32
observations.E: fork_s11 (fork_t 2000) vs pack_s11: 32 -> 0 vortices between t=2025 and t=2070, fed 29-31 (metrics.json series n_comp)

verdicts.limitation: E is by construction: vorticity grows only through k Y s omega and decays at mu, so emptying the fuel must kill every vortex (the author says so). The genealogy is reticulate (merge/split 0.84-0.87, near the 50%-of-splits cap the rubric names, so confidence is medium); fission needs the strain of neighbours. Two fresh seeds at the default grid and dt; I did not run the no-advection twin or a resolution variant.
